queries.sql: SELECT `researchers`.*, `users`.`username`, `users`.`email`, `research_categories`.`name` as `category_name`, `designations`.`name` as `designation_name`, `school_years`.`name` as `school_year_name`, `strands`.`name` as `strand_name`, `courses`.`name` as `course_name`, `advisers`.`name` as `adviser_name`, `grammarians`.`name` as `grammarian_name`, `remarks`.`name` as `remark_name` FROM `researchers` LEFT JOIN `users` ON `users`.`id` = `researchers`.`user_id` LEFT JOIN `research_categories` ON `research_categories`.`id` = `researchers`.`category_id` LEFT JOIN `designations` ON `designations`.`id` = `researchers`.`designation_id` LEFT JOIN `school_years` ON `school_years`.`id` = `researchers`.`school_year_id` LEFT JOIN `strands` ON `strands`.`id` = `researchers`.`strand_id` LEFT JOIN `courses` ON `courses`.`id` = `researchers`.`course_id` LEFT JOIN `advisers` ON `advisers`.`id` = `researchers`.`adviser_id` LEFT JOIN `grammarians` ON `grammarians`.`id` = `researchers`.`grammarian_id` LEFT JOIN `remarks` ON `remarks`.`id` = `researchers`.`remark_id` ORDER BY `researchers`.`created_at` DESC
